name: unismiles-root
description: Root workspace to run all UniSmiles projects concurrently

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix unismiles-backend && npm install --prefix unismiles-admin && npm install --prefix unismiles-photobooth && npm install --prefix kiosk-agent
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "backend,admin,booth,agents,vision" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-backend" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-admin" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-photobooth" "node --watch multi-agent.js" "python3 payment-vision-service/main.py"
scripts.dev:apps: npx concurrently -k -n "booth,admin" -c "bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-photobooth" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-admin"
scripts.dev:web: npx concurrently -k -n "backend,admin,booth,vision" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-backend" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-admin" "npm run dev --prefix unismiles-photobooth" "python3 payment-vision-service/main.py"
